Hi Samir,

Thanks for moving quickly on onboarding Cerulean. Finance put PO #PO-48271 on hold pending final tax documentation and a short signatory confirmation (standard for non-US vendors). To get the PO released we need the following: 

- Completed W-8BEN-E (signed) OR a completed W-9 if the company is US-based (it looks like Cerulean is foreign – please confirm).
- A short signed affidavit (on company letterhead) confirming the authorized signer for tax forms (name, title, and email) and confirming they are authorized to sign on behalf of the entity.
- A copy of the certificate of incorporation or equivalent (for beneficial ownership verification).

Can you confirm whether you will provide W-8BEN-E vs W-9 and share an ETA? If you already have these in DocuSign or your AP portal, a link is fine. Finance (cc'd) needs the docs to clear the PO.

If any of the items above are sensitive, you can send via the DocuSign link or secure portal.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — the customer success team is waiting to schedule kickoff once the PO is active.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
